caption: The video captures a single-story house with a hipped roof and a slender metal vent pipe on its ridge, framed by tall evergreen trees and seen over a dark horizontal fence. Bright backlight from the upper right throws diagonal sun-ray streaks and lens flares across the frame. A pale, translucent plume of smoke or steam is already hanging in front of the house, rising up past the left portion of the roofline. Throughout the clip the column billows upward and drifts toward the upper right, its outline deforming, widening, and growing more diffuse near the top as it climbs. The plume remains present from the first frame to the last, so the excerpt shows an ongoing process with no visible onset or completion. The sun-ray streaks persist the whole time, varying only subtly in brightness and angle. The house, vent pipe, and trees shift slowly rightward across the frame, a small gradual camera drift. The smoke column, by contrast, stays roughly fixed relative to the left roof edge. The foreground fence and the round object on the left roof remain steady against the house.
relations: The pale plume rises and drifts upper right, widening and deforming while staying anchored near the left roof edge.
Camera drift shifts house and trees rightward, while foreground fence and roof objects remain steady relative to the house.
Bright backlight from the upper right sustains diagonal sun-ray streaks across the frame throughout the ongoing smoke emission.
